mentions.name: Innocuous
mentions.description: A tool for encoding and decoding hidden messages in LLM output. It supports steganography ("hidden writing") and is being explored for applications beyond covert communication. The project also serves as a case study for AI-assisted development, tracking every prompt and generated code line in a markdown dev summary.
